name: Visual Studio Code
purpose: Develop, inspect, debug and maintain the application.
limitations: Extensions/configuration may be required for specialized tooling.

name: GitHub
purpose: Store source code, collaborate and review changes.
strengths: Version history, pull requests and issue tracking.

name: FastAPI
purpose: Expose backend web/API endpoints and application services.
strengths: Fast, typed Python API framework with automatic API documentation.
limitations: Additional libraries are needed for authentication, persistence and domain features.

name: SQLAlchemy
purpose: Map domain entities to relational tables and execute database queries/transactions.
strengths: Reusable ORM and transaction support; testable with SQLite.
limitations: Database-specific behavior depends on configured backend.

name: SQLite
purpose: Provide an isolated relational database for automated tests.
strengths: Fast, zero-configuration and suitable for unit/integration test isolation.
limitations: Not assumed to be the production database engine.

name: Pytest
purpose: Execute automated unit/integration tests for business rules.
strengths: Fixtures, assertions and readable test structure.
limitations: End-to-end browser testing requires additional tooling.

name: HTML/CSS/Frontend UI
purpose: Provide browser-based pages/forms for authentication, catalogue, registration and administration.
strengths: Direct user interaction and broad browser accessibility.
limitations: UI behavior depends on the selected frontend implementation.
